lesson.meaning: The good result you get when you achieve something you wanted or worked for.
examples: Our team's project was a huge success because everyone worked together.
She found great success in her new role by focusing on customer satisfaction.
To achieve success in the meeting, we need to prepare our presentation well.
Learning new skills is key to long-term success in any career.
Getting this promotion feels like a big success after all my hard work.
lesson.memory_tip: Remember, 'success' often comes after hard work and clear goals!
